Gold: illness started with sore throat then progressed to dry cough. Generated hpi-001: sore throat started first followed by cough 1–2 days later, consistent and more specific.

Gold: cough is non-productive with no sputum. Generated hpi-009: patient reports no sputum production, and cc-001/hpi-019/asm-001 describe a dry/nonproductive cough. Combined, these cover the gold fact.
Gold: no blood in cough. Generated hpi-010, hpi-019, asm-001 explicitly report no hemoptysis, which is equivalent.
Gold: patient denies chest pain. Generated hpi-007, hpi-019, asm-001 state chest pain is present, which contradicts rather than covers the gold denial.

Gold: mild SOB, not at rest, not limiting activity. Generated hpi-002, hpi-004, hpi-005, hpi-003, hpi-019, asm-001 describe exertional SOB, not at rest, maintaining ADLs, matching and expanding the gold information.
Gold: slight fever symptoms. Generated hpi-011: feverish for first ~3 days, now resolved. This is consistent and adds temporal detail.
Gold: symptoms are gradually improving. Generated facts describe fluctuating course (hpi-003, hpi-019, asm-001) but do not state overall gradual improvement.
Gold: reduced appetite. Generated hpi-013 and asm-003: appetite decreased/reduced; clearly covered.
Gold: denies unintentional weight loss. Generated hpi-014 and asm-003: no perceived/without weight loss; equivalent.
Gold: denies history of asthma. Generated pmh-002: no history of asthma; directly aligned.
Gold: no significant past medical history. Generated pmh-001: PMH none; equivalent to no significant PMH.

Gold: NKDA (no known drug allergies). Generated allergy-001: peanut allergy, which contradicts this instead of covering it.
Gold: mother had lung cancer. Generated fh-001: mother—lung cancer; same fact.
Gold: non-smoker. Generated sh-001: non-smoker but experimented once or twice; still classified as non-smoker clinically, so this covers and adds detail.
Gold: no asbestos exposure. Generated sh-002: no known asbestos exposure; equivalent.

Gold: expected to improve within 5 days, review if not better. Generated plan-002 and fu-001: expect improvement over next 4–5 days, arrange in-person GP review if not improving; equivalent.
